MilioQ.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
MilioQ.tooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing @Damage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmountPercent@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds @RefundRatio*100@% of it's Mana cost.
Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.

damageRefs.context: bility deals @ADBurstRatio@ ally Attack Damage as additional magic damage, plus [{BurnDamage} magic damage] over @BurnDuration@ seconds.

MilioPassive.name: Fired Up!
MilioPassive.tooltip: When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals <physicalDamage>@ADBurstRatio@ ally Attack Damage</physicalDamage> as additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>, plus <magicDamage>@BurnDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @BurnDuration@ seconds.

MilioR.name: Breath of Life
MilioR.tooltip:
Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring @HealCalc@ Health, and granting @TenacityAmount*100@% Tenacity for @TenacityDuration@ seconds.
Does not cleanse Airborne.

MilioE.name: Warm Hugs
MilioE.tooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting @ShieldCalc@ Shield and @MoveSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.

MilioW.name: Cozy Campfire
MilioW.tooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Ally champions nearby gain @RangePercent@ Attack Range and restore @HealingOverTime@ Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every @HealFrequencySeconds@ seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
